# Calculator Soup

> > Calculator Soup is a comprehensive online platform offering free calculators for mathematics, algebra, geometry, statistics, finance, and practical everyday calculations.

Calculator Soup provides an extensive directory of specialized calculators organized by mathematical discipline and financial application. The site serves students, professionals, and everyday users needing quick computational tools for everything from basic arithmetic to complex financial analysis.

## Key Topics

- Basic Calculator
- Math Calculators
- Algebra Calculators
- Geometry Calculators
- Fractions
- Percentages
- Statistics
- Financial Calculators
- Loan Calculators
- Compound Interest
- Trigonometry
- Discrete Mathematics
- Financial Ratios
- Time Value of Money
- Sales and Retail

## Core Calculators & Directory

- [Calculator Soup Homepage](https://www.calculatorsoup.com): Homepage showcasing Calculator Soup's directory of math, finance, and practical calculators.
- [Calculator Index](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators): Main index organizing calculators by category: finance, algebra, math, geometry, and more.
- [Basic Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/math/basic.php): Basic online calculator with arithmetic operations and memory functions.

## Mathematics Calculators

- [Math Calculators](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/math): Math calculators for factors, fractions, scientific notation, and percentages.
- [Fractions Calculators](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/math/fractionscalculators.php): Fractions calculators for operations, simplification, conversion, and equation solving.
- [Algebra Calculators](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/algebra): Algebra calculators for roots, exponents, radicals, and equation solving.
- [Percentage Calculators](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/percent-calculators.php): Percentage calculators for increase, decrease, tips, taxes, and discounts.
- [Statistics Calculators](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/statistics): Statistics calculators for descriptive analysis, GPA, grades, and data measures.

## Geometry & Trigonometry Calculators

- [Geometry Calculators](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/geometry-calculators.php): Geometry calculators for plane, solid geometry, and trigonometric functions.
- [Plane Geometry Calculators](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/geometry-plane): Plane geometry calculators for shapes: circles, triangles, polygons, area.
- [Solid Geometry Calculators](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/geometry-solids): Solid geometry calculators for 3D shapes: volume, surface area, spheres, cones.
- [Trigonometry Calculators](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/trigonometry): Trigonometry calculators for functions, inverse functions, and trigonometric ratios.

## Financial Calculators

- [Loan Calculators](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/financial/index-loan-calculators.php): Loan calculators for mortgages, auto loans, personal loans with amortization.
- [Interest and APR Calculators](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/financial/index-interest-apr-calculators.php): Interest calculators for APR, compound interest, and effective annual rates.
- [Time Value of Money Calculators](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/financial/index-time-value-of-money-calculators.php): Time value calculators for present/future value, annuities, and investments.
- [Financial Ratio Calculators](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/financial/index-financial-ratio-calculators.php): Financial ratio calculators for profitability, debt, liquidity, operations analysis.
- [Sales and Retail Calculators](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/financial/index-sales-calculators.php): Sales calculators for markup, margin, profit, pricing, and sales tax.

## Specialized Mathematics Calculators

- [Discrete Mathematics Calculators](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/discretemathematics): Discrete math calculators for factorials, combinations, permutations, Fibonacci.
- [Ratio Calculators](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/ratio-calculators.php): Ratio calculators for proportions, aspect ratios, financial and statistics ratios.
